message.content: In one of the discussions, MalfurionStormrage suggests setting up a little gathering once the flowers are settled. He emphasizes the importance of creating a nice atmosphere for the community and mentions that the gathering could be a "nice way to enjoy the garden together." Additionally, he proposes setting up a little area for children, possibly including crafts or simple games to keep them entertained while enjoying the garden. However, no specific activities are detailed beyond these suggestions.
